plain_english_summary: This plan covers CRM, lead capture, email, customer segmentation, incentives, analytics, dashboarding, and monthly product trend intelligence.

integrations.why: Stores customers, contact details, orders, tags, segments, and marketing status.

integrations.starting_tool: Shopify Forms or compatible form app
integrations.why: Captures voluntary sign-ups, country, interest, consent, and lead magnet request.
Low-cost way to start welcome emails and weekly newsletters.
Useful when segmentation, automation, and email revenue justify extra cost.
Tracks lead, product, cart, checkout, purchase, and campaign behaviour.

integrations.starting_tool: Shopify analytics plus Looker Studio later
integrations.why: Shows conversion, email, offer, and trend performance visually.

integrations.starting_tool: Monthly manual trend report using Google Trends, marketplace checks, supplier checks, and store data
integrations.why: Chooses new products analytically before sampling.
Only needed when Shopify, email, ad, supplier, and trend data become too complex for exports.

secrets_policy: No API keys, passwords, tokens, private customer exports, or real email lists may be committed to this repository.
